command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out
python3 -u fetch.py /tmp/out > /tmp/out/fetch.log 2>&1
RC=$?
cat /tmp/out/fetch.log
[ "$RC" = 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: fetch"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
